ns2:course.label: Case Stud Agr Accy & Fin Plan
ns2:course.description: Capstone course for agricultural accounting, agricultural finance, and financial planning; applies business and planning concepts and tools to real-world situations; emphasizes group decision making; industry professions participate in the learning experience. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One of ACCY 301, ACE 444, FIN 300; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One of ACCY 301, ACE 444, FIN 300; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:ACE - Agri-Accounting -UIUC, BS:ACE - Agri-Finance - UIUC, BS: ACE: Finl Planning -UIUC, or BS: ACE - Fin AgrBusns - UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Agr & Consumer Economics department.
